name: ezpowers
description: Repository documentation, specialized diagnosis and codebase design, specification, verified harness chains, evidence, and resume support for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Repository docs, engineering diagnosis, verified chains, and evidence.
interface.longDescription: EZPowers keeps repository documentation, local session knowledge, project-specific intent, plans, verification commands, approved harness chains, completion evidence, and resume state consistent across Claude Code and Codex. Its retained skills are ezpowers:setup, ezpowers:deep-interview, ezpowers:diagnose, ezpowers:codebase-design, ezpowers:improve-codebase-architecture, ezpowers:design-architecture, ezpowers:spec, ezpowers:prepare-execute, ezpowers:execute, ezpowers:frontend-design, ezpowers:wiki, ezpowers:harness-chain, and ezpowers:hud. Native host features remain responsible for coding, subagents, worktrees, sandboxing, and general retry behavior.
defaultPrompt: $ezpowers:setup Install the project-local EZPowers workflow and verification kit.
$ezpowers:deep-interview Clarify this request, surface consequential blind spots, and, if Plan Mode is already active, continue planning after confirmation.
$ezpowers:harness-chain Configure or run this project's approved verified harness chain.
